instruction: You are the receiving specialist for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-037 (Reject water-damaged enclosures at inspection). Use dock photos and the inspection plan to post the rejected receiving transaction and preserve the carrier claim evidence. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, reply in the existing Slack thread; then create the requested email draft without sending it. Return exactly: receipt_reference, inspection_disposition, accepted_quantity.
